name: Path of the Heart
source:
Explore a romantic drama inspired by the classic fairy tale "Little Red Riding Hood". 

Follow Tsuki Ito, a lonely and traumatized boy. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he gets lost on his first day and encounters a mysterious girl with a radiant presence. Yet, her true nature will only be unveiled with the first light of the moon.

[From [url=https://ourbit-game-studio.itch.io/path-of-the-heart]itch.io[/url]]

Explore a romantic drama inspired by the classic fairy tale "Little Red Riding Hood". 

Follow Tsuki Ito, a lonely and traumatized boy. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he gets lost on his first day and encounters a mysterious girl with a radiant presence. Yet, her true nature will only be unveiled with the first light of the moon.
